audit.whatIsWrong: The two layers disagree on six of seven stages. content.win reads Cassiopeia / Cassiopeia / Cassiopeia / Skill / Cassiopeia / Skill / Cassiopeia; CHAMP_FULL.phases reads Poppy / Skill / Skill / Poppy / Cassiopeia / Skill / Poppy. content.win also contradicts its own whys, which say Poppy wins level 1, walks you down at 4-5 and reclaims the lane on tank items.
audit.why: The full chart and the whys agree with each other and with a 46.94% Emerald+ rate over 49 games. This is the one losing lane in the slice and the content chart hands Cassiopeia five stages of it.
audit.corrected: content.win should be set to Poppy / Skill / Skill / Poppy / Cassiopeia / Skill / Poppy. Not proposed as edits: single-word side values cannot change inside the +/-10% length band. Flagged for a manual pass.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere, and the level 3 spike says Miasma "cancels her E Heroic Charge" without saying how long that buys you.
audit.why: Heroic Charge is 14/13/12/11/10 — grounding it once is a 14-second window at rank 1 in which Poppy has no way to reach you, which is the entire reason the level 3 spike exists.

audit.whatIsWrong: Iron Ambassador is described as "point-and-click" hammer poke in spikes[0].text, whys[0] and early. It is a thrown buckler that bounces off the target and shields her when she picks it up. And Keeper's Verdict is a channel that Petrifying Gaze cancels outright — the single best fact in this matchup and it appears nowhere.
audit.why: Riot: "Poppy throws her buckler that bounces off the target. Poppy can pick it up to gain a temporary shield" — a dodgeable projectile with a shield attached, not point-and-click. And "Poppy channels a hammer strike"; the kit file flags R channel, "interruptible — any CC cancels it". Petrifying Gaze is the hard CC that ends it.
audit.corrected: Iron Ambassador restated as a thrown, retrievable, shielding buckler; the Keeper's Verdict cancel written into spikes[3].text and wants.you[2].

edits.before: Poppy's Iron Ambassador hammer is point-and-click poke and her W Steadfast Presence already taxes you, so she out-trades your lone Q Noxious Blast before any poison stacks.
edits.after: Iron Ambassador is a thrown buckler she picks back up for a shield, and Steadfast Presence (W) adds resists, so she out-trades your lone Noxious Blast before any poison stacks.

edits.before: W Miasma comes online: its ground cancels her E Heroic Charge mid-dash, the only tool that stops her pinning you to a wall for the stun.
edits.after: W Miasma comes online: grounding cancels Heroic Charge (E) mid-dash and leaves her one gap-close down 14s before she can try the wall stun.

edits.after: Poppy's MR and HP gut your Twin Fang DPS, but Keeper's Verdict is a channel your Petrifying Gaze cancels if she faces you.

edits.after: Reach 6 and hold Petrifying Gaze to cancel her Keeper's Verdict channel or stun her E commit

edits.after: Stack MR and HP so your poison barely scratches her while Iron Ambassador pickups keep re-shielding her chip
